# sh-fpv-footer

**Purpose:** End of the profile: Shortlist, Share, Manage your boundaries, and a settled reward.

**Switches:** State.

**Taps:** Shortlist (toggle) · Share · Hide, Report or Block Profile → sh-fpv-sheet-manage-boundaries (Choose → confirm → end state).

Full profile view (migration, not yet core) · 5 variants · [Open in Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/l1SuD1Q1l8QXGvtomszGYW/Shaadi-DNA?node-id=2877-20188) (node `2877:20188`)

*Generated by `tools/components.py` from Figma. Values are token names; never copy numbers.*

## Types

### State=Default

**When:** while scrolling the profile.

### State=Settled · Quote reward

**When:** settled at the end; quote reward.

### State=Settled · Success story

**When:** settled at the end; success story.

### State=Settled · Premium (unclaimed)

**When:** Premium viewer, free contact reveal not claimed. Claim My Free Unlock.

### State=Settled · Premium (claimed)

**When:** after claiming. Free Unlock Claimed.
